component.name: NEO-M9N Monitor
component.summary: Diagnose and monitor a u-blox NEO-M9N GNSS receiver

description.p: NEO-M9N Monitor tests a SparkFun u-blox NEO-M9N receiver connected directly over USB and shows live GNSS data. It gives explicit evidence for USB and serial failures, loss of fix, frozen navigation epochs, checksum failures and receiver-reported RF or firmware errors.

ul.li: Live fix, position, motion, timing and receiver identity
Sortable satellite table with signal levels and a sky plot
RF, antenna, spoofing and diagnostic freshness indicators
Timed device test with a PASS, WARN or FAIL report
Raw capture, JSONL snapshot and application log evidence files, plus replay
Host diagnostics for USB access, drivers and competing services

description.p: The receiver is only sent read-only diagnostic polls; its configuration is never changed, and passive mode sends nothing at all.
The command-line interface is replaced by this GTK 4 and libadwaita desktop application.
